subject: Meridian Health: stakeholder assignments & PO cadence (post-discovery)
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Meridian Health: stakeholder assignments & PO cadence (post-discovery)

Hi Elena — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the asks we agreed to capture so we can move toward a pilot PO: 

- Confirmed stakeholders we heard: Tom Bartlett (SVP, Clinical Ops) as economic buyer, Nina Patel (Procurement) as procurement lead, and Security will be looped by Nina (names TBD).
- Meridian needs vendor onboarding (standard intake form), SOC 2 evidence, and a short SOW + invoicing cadence for legal and finance review.
- Target procurement window: Meridian indicated early October for PO issuance but we didn’t lock a date.

Action items / next steps: 
1) Elena — please confirm the economic buyer and the procurement contact details and share any vendor intake form or vendor packet you require.
2) Marissa — I’ve copied you to prepare our vendor packet (SOW + billing info + vendor intake answers) and a first-pass contract redline.
3) Karthik — please gather SOC 2 summary and estimated timeline for any additional security artifacts Meridian may request (data flow diagram, subprocessors list).

If you confirm Tom and Nina, I’ll schedule a short meeting with them to align on the PO target date and required document list. Happy to prioritize any doc you need this week.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Sr. Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@meridianhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Bartlett <t.bartlett@meridianhealth.com>, Nina Patel <nina.patel@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Meridian Health: stakeholder assignments & PO cadence (post-discovery)

Thanks, Sergio — good summary. Confirmation below: 

- Economic buyer: Tom Bartlett (t.bartlett@meridianhealth.com) — he asked to be kept brief and focused on expected outcomes and cost.
- Procurement lead: Nina Patel (nina.patel@meridianhealth.com) — procurement@meridianhealth.com is monitored by her team for vendor packets.
- Security: Nina will bring in our InfoSec SME after she reviews the initial SOC 2 summary.

Procurement timeline: our best estimate is PO issuance week of Oct 4–8. The vendor intake form is attached — it lists mandatory items: vendor contact, billing address, W9 (for US vendors), estimated MRR/annual contract value, and copies of SOC 2 / data-handling documentation.

A couple of asks from our side: 
- Please provide a simple billing contact and whether you invoice monthly or net-30 annually.
- If you have an onboarding SOW with milestones, include it so Legal can see scope and acceptance criteria.

I’m attaching the Vendor Intake Form for your packet. I’ll be available for a 15-minute sync with Tom and Sergio next Tuesday (Sep 21) between 10–11am ET if that works — otherwise we can do Oct 5 as a follow-up.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Strategic Sourcing | Meridian Health
elena.ruiz@meridianhealth.com

Attachments: Vendor-Intake-Form_Meridian.pdf (form fields + required evidence)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Meridian Health: stakeholder assignments & PO cadence (post-discovery)

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Elena's confirmation and attached intake form. Key asks from Meridian: billing contact, W9, SOC 2 summary, SOW with milestones, and an estimated contract value. They expect PO issuance around Oct 4–8.

Marissa — can you assemble: SOW (2–3 page with milestones & acceptance), billing contact + W9, and our responses to the intake form? Please mark any open pricing questions I should raise to Elena.

Karthik — can you extract the SOC 2 summary + list of subprocessors and a short note on how we handle PHI (if asked) so we can hand to InfoSec? If we anticipate needing an MSA redline, flag the top 3 clauses we typically see pushed back (data residency, indemnity, liability cap).

I’ll aim to get a 15–20 minute sync on Sep 21 with Tom and Elena but if Oct 5 is better, let me know.

Thanks — Sergio

Subject: Re: Fwd: Meridian Health: stakeholder assignments & PO cadence (post-discovery)

All — attaching the initial vendor packet for Meridian. Files attached: Vendor-Intake-Form_Meridian.pdf (filled), Redlines_v1.docx (MSA redline, highlights), SOC2-summary.pdf (one-page summary + link to full report upon NDA).

Notes: 
- SOW: kept to 2 pages (pilot scope, acceptance criteria, go/no-go milestones). See SOW section in the filled intake form.
- Billing: we bill monthly by invoice net-30. Billing contact: Finance AP team — ap@redwoodinference.com; W9 included in vendor packet.
- Pricing: estimated 3-month pilot spend ~ $23,500 USD (monthly invoiced usage + 1-time onboarding). I marked price as provisional in the intake form; Elena / procurement may request a fixed commitment.

Karthik — SOC2 summary included; I flagged the parts where Meridian may request subprocessors and encryption details. If you can draft a 1-paragraph response for PHI handling, I’ll slot it into the packet.

Next actions I’ll take: upload these to our shared Drive folder and send the redline as a tracked Word doc. Sergio, let me know if you want me to book the Sep 21 10:30am ET slot with Elena & Tom — I can send a calendar invite and include a brief agenda.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Contracts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Elena / Tom / Nina — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the intake form. We’ve attached the packet (Marissa looped in) and confirmed billing contact and W9. Quick alignment and next steps: 

- Proposed pilot PO target: week of Oct 4 (open to Oct 5 or Oct 7 signing).
- We will provide a final SOW + tracked MSA redline by Sep 17 EOD so your Legal team has time for review.
- Marissa will join the procurement review; Karthik will stand by for any InfoSec questions.
- I’ll schedule a 25-minute call on Sep 21 at 10:30am ET (per Elena’s suggested slot) — sending invite now, feel free to propose an alternate.

If Nat or anyone from Finance needs a different invoicing cadence, let us know; otherwise we’ll proceed with monthly net-30 invoices to the AP email provided.

Appreciate it — looking forward to getting the packet in front of Tom and moving toward PO.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
